source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Brakes, p.5-5

procedures.title: Brake bleeding: manual method
steps: Refit the main cylinder diaphragm and cover.

procedures.title: Brake pedal push rod to main cylinder clearance: adjust
steps: Check that the pedal comes fully back on its own and that the pedal return spring still has its tension.
Loosen the push rod check nut.
Turn the push rod until the pedal pad moves 1/16 to 1/4 in. before the rod touches the main cylinder pistons (see figure 8 in the manual).
Tighten the check nut against the clevis and check the free movement again.

specs.what: brake pedal free movement before push rod contacts main cylinder pistons

notes: The pedal stop is a fixed, non-adjustable rubber bumper at the released end of pedal travel.
The text cites fig. 9, but the 1/16-1/4 in. dimension appears in figure 8 (Brake Pedal Free Movement).

procedures.title: Hydraulic brake hose: remove and install
notes: The flexible hoses carry pressure from the steel lines to the wheel brakes (description continues on the next page).
